title: The Saying the Soup Was Too Hot
youtube_title: The Saying the Soup Was Too Hot | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Being new at something is not the same as failing.
summary: At a library story circle, Bodhi feels shy about a truth that the soup was still too hot for a little cousin. Instead of pretending not to care, Bodhi tries the smallest brave version in a voice that can be heard, while Auntie June stays kind and does not push for a show.
